items.title: Feijóo se refuerza en el Congreso: portavoces de la línea dura, veteranos y experiencia de gestión con miras al Gobierno
items.description: Alberto Núñez Feijóo ha decidido llevar a cabo una renovación profunda de las listas del Partido Popular al Congreso para las elecciones del próximo 29 de noviembre con la vista puesta en un futuro Gobierno de la derecha. El PP va poco a poco desvelando las candidaturas y el resultado hasta ahora es un cambio de calado en los cuadros del partido. El líder del PP se refuerza en el Parlamento con portavoces de la línea dura, como Cayetana Álvarez de Toledo y Xavier García Albiol, pero también con perfiles de gestión, como consejeros de Gobiernos autonómicos y alcaldes, lo que está obligando a remodelaciones en las comunidades autónomas. Y con más veteranos, algunos de los cuales saltan del Senado al Congreso. Se trata de construir “un grupo parlamentario sólido”, apuntan en Génova, del que saldrán muchos cargos gubernamentales si Feijóo llega al poder. Seguir leyendo

items.title: El vídeo del PP contra el PSOE agita el debate sobre los límites de la IA en la batalla política
items.description: La última ofensiva del PP lanzada en redes sociales contra el PSOE —un vídeo que suplanta con inteligencia artificial (IA) la identidad, entre otros, de Begoña Gómez, José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero y Santos Cerdán— ha crispado aún más los ánimos de esta descarnada precampaña electoral. Los socialistas han anunciado que estudian emprender acciones legales contra los conservadores, que defienden que no tenían la intención “espuria de hacer creer que los personajes que aparecen ahí son los reales”. “Todo el mundo es capaz de interpretar que es una manera de utilizar las herramientas digitales para comunicar la hipocresía en la que vive el PSOE”, se ha amparado el portavoz nacional de los populares, Borja Sémper. Sin embargo, más allá de este caso concreto, la iniciativa del partido de la calle Génova evidencia la irrupción de esta nueva tecnología en el terreno político e intensifica el debate sobre sus límites y su influencia irregular en el voto. Seguir leyendo

items.title: El rufianismo existe
items.description: Cómo ganar a los fachas (leer antes de votar) , de Gabriel Rufián , deja en la boca un fuerte sabor electoral. No es una simple puesta en negro sobre blanco de su cruzada contra la ultraderecha. El libro del portavoz de Esquerra Republicana de Catalunya (ERC) en el Congreso rezuma programa político, tal vez proyectado para un escenario diferente al de candidato republicano el 29-N. Da la sensación de que el texto estaba siendo parido para unas elecciones generales más tardías y cuyo adelanto no ha permitido que muchas otras cosas maduraran, entre ellas el papel mismo de Rufián . Pero con todo, certifica que el rufianismo existe y aspira a algo más. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Escribir literatura en un periódico
items.description: No creo que tenga ningún sentido esa distinción tan frecuente entre literatura y periodismo. La literatura se hace de diversas maneras, en lugares o espacios distintos: el libro, el escenario, el periódico. No me refiero a la colaboración literaria sin más, a lo que se llama “la firma”, para distinguir a quien escribe de los periodistas sujetos a las obligaciones y los ritmos de la actualidad. El periodista es tan literato como el novelista o el poeta. Hay novelistas buenos y malos, como hay poetas, o autores dramáticos, y periodistas también. No es que el periodismo sea un género inferior, o menor, siguiendo la manía jerárquica que tanto daño hace a la percepción justa de lo escrito. Tampoco las fotos que se publican en el papel de periódico son de por sí inferiores a las que se exhiben bien impresas y enmarcadas en las galerías de arte. Las fotos de asesinos y mendigos de Weegee se publicaban en las páginas del New York Post en los años cuarenta, y las de Cartier-Bresson o André Kertész y tantos otros ilustraron la edad de oro de las revistas gráficas. En España, por no ir tan lejos, uno de los mejores fotógrafos del siglo XX fue el gran Santos Yubero, que retrataba lo mismo la celebración del 14 de abril en Cibeles que la faena de un torero o una jugada de fútbol, y al que nadie otorgó consideración de artista mientras vivía. En los años treinta escritores de mucho postín —Unamuno, Baroja— firmaban artículos en los periódicos, pero su prosa, leída hoy, es más vacua y retórica que la de los reportajes espléndidos de Chaves Nogales , Josefina Carabias, Gaziel, Josep Pla . Cuando yo tenía 14 o 15 años, allá por los primeros setenta del siglo pasado, mi aspiración de ser escritor era inseparable de la de ser periodista, y mis héroes eran Manu Leguineche y otro gran reportero ahora olvidado, Enrique Meneses , que había sido el primero en localizar y entrevistar a Fidel Castro en Sierra Maestra. Seguir leyendo El País Semanal 50 Aniversario Este artículo forma parte del especial aniversario de la revista que se publica en su edición impresa el domingo 25 de octubre.

items.title: El primer salto del shamonda a un humano: qué se sabe de un virus emergente que ha sorprendido a los expertos
items.description: La muerte de una persona en Francia infectada por el virus shamonda (SHAV) ha puesto en alerta a los organismos europeos de salud pública. “Estamos vigilando de cerca la situación después de que las autoridades francesas hayan anunciado el primer caso registrado de infección humana por shamonda, una enfermedad que hasta ahora solo había afectado a animales”, ha publicado en un comunicado el Centro Europeo para el Control de Enfermedades (ECDC). Seguir leyendo

items.title: Los nostálgicos de Franco disparan los precios en la puja del pazo de Meirás
items.description: La casa de subastas Magna Art, que comparte la calle Núñez de Balboa con unas cuantas afamadas galerías de Madrid, es ahora la más concurrida. Público de todas las edades, incluso veinteañeros clásicamente vestidos, peregrina allí y se adentra hasta el fondo del local, donde se mantiene abierto, ante un tapiz antiguo, el despacho del director. De principio a fin, todo el espacio de Magna Art Auctions está invadido por el atrezzo de la dictadura franquista que se retiró del pazo de Meirás este verano, ante la impotencia de las asociaciones por la memoria. Ahora estos colectivos y estudiosos de la historia del palacete escudriñan el catálogo de la galería convencidos de que se han marchado de Galicia muebles y objetos que deberían haberse quedado y ya decoraban el pazo con su primera propietaria, Emilia Pardo Bazán . Seguir leyendo

items.title: ‘Sentido y sensibilidad’: vean ‘Sentido y sensibilidad’. La antigua, por supuesto
items.description: No recuerdo si pertenece a un poema o a una canción algo tan incontestable como: “No hay que volver al lugar donde fuiste feliz”. Por si acaso, para protegerse, para evitar el desencanto. Y no me importa que en el cine recurran machaconamente al remake, a condición de que yo no tenga la obligación de tragármelos. Casi siempre son decepcionantes. Sobre todo los que vuelven a contar historias que te donaron encanto, emoción; las sensaciones que te regala lo que tú identificas con el gran cine. Seguir leyendo Sentido y sensibilidad Dirección: Georgia Oakley. Intérpretes: Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles, George MacKay, Fiona Shaw, Stacy Martin, Caitríona Balfe. Género: drama. Reino Unido, 2026. Duración: 132 minutos. Estreno: 23 de octubre.

items.title: Javier Moreno, premiado imitador del canto de los pájaros: “Me costará superar el jilguero”
items.description: Uno de los momentos estelares del pasado Delta Birding Festival , la popular feria de ornitología que se desarrolla desde hace doce ediciones cada septiembre en tierras del delta del Ebro (Tarragona), fue el concurso de imitación del canto y reclamo de pájaros, que se celebraba por primera vez. De la seriedad de la convocatoria da fe que formara parte del jurado Peter Boesman, experto mundial en la materia y que ha grabado las voces de más de la mitad de las aves que existen. El ganador a la mejor imitación, haciendo el jilguero, resultó el biólogo catalán Javier Moreno (Santa Coloma de Gramenet, 40 años), personaje bien conocido (y apreciado) en la comunidad birder y que trabaja en la librería y tienda de equipamiento para amantes de la naturaleza Oryx. Allí le entrevistamos. Seguir leyendo

items.title: ‘Grande de España’, una sátira de la aristocracia con forma de comedia romántica
items.description: Los orígenes de Grande de España , la nueva serie de Netflix, tienen algo de metatelevisión. Mientras visitaban casas para rodar otra serie, los cineastas Juan Cavestany y Álvaro Fernández Armero se encontraron con que se repetía una misma situación: en un momento de la visita al opulento y decadente espacio aparece, tras una puerta que da a una zona fría y desangelada, el hijo de la dueña. Se trata de un hombre de cuarenta y tantos que no ha prosperado en la vida y reside en la casa como si de un guardés se tratara. Algunas de esas anécdotas en pisos que se alquilan para rodajes con el fin de poder cubrir los gastos de su mantenimiento están en los cimientos de la nueva historia de los creadores de Vergüenza y Sentimos las molestias . Eso les recordó a la película de Berlanga Patrimonio nacional , “y empezamos a fantasear con ese Madrid de palacetes y de cierta ranciedad de dinero muy antiguo”, explica Cavestany en conversación por videollamada. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Exiliados: España ha muerto
items.description: I . Iba Cernuda por una calleja de Londres y una sombra lo seguía. El poeta sevillano acababa de llegar al exilio , ese mundo sin raíces lleno de cartas por escribir y recuerdos que llorar. Atrás quedaba su tierra sangrante y en ruinas mientras él se preguntaba qué puede el hombre contra la locura de todos. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Peleas invisibles
items.description: En el interior de una frase se producen tensiones de carácter sintáctico, semántico, silábico, fonético, ortográfico… Una palabra tira de otra que a su vez depende de una tercera, mientras el verbo intenta dirigir el tráfico y los adjetivos tratan de hacerse notar porque son muy narcisos. La puntuación vigila el conjunto. Una coma mal puesta puede provocar una catástrofe gramatical y un punto prematuro romper el ritmo de la oración. Lo increíble es que no percibamos la actividad bárbara de todas esas fuerzas al leer el periódico o un libro o un pasquín o una receta de cocina. Una buena frase parece inmóvil, aunque sea el fruto de una descarga sentimental insoportable. La atraviesas como se cruza una habitación en la que cada mueble ocupa su lugar, sin considerar que el techo pesa toneladas ni que las paredes se sostienen gracias a un pacto milagroso entre energías de diferente signo. Si de pronto se oye un crujido, levantamos con susto la cabeza. También al leer levantamos la cabeza cuando el texto hace ruido. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Premios Princesa de Asturias 2026: galardonados muy queridos y nuevos retos para la princesa Leonor
items.description: Este viernes, en el Teatro Campoamor de Oviedo, se entregan en solemne gala, como cada otoño, los Premios Princesa de Asturias . Durante la Semana de los Premios se han ido sucediendo las llegadas de los galardonados para ser recibidos, con las tradicionales gaitas, a las puertas del Hotel de la Reconquista, ante la congregación de cientos de curiosos, acostumbrados a ver cada año pasar por esas escaleras a mentes y cuerpos preclaros del arte, el deporte o el pensamiento. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Messi frente a Messi
items.description: Leo Messi se empieza a dar cuenta a los 39 años de que a menudo no ha disfrutado de sus goles y de sus éxitos tanto como se merecían, ni siquiera en los momentos de plenitud, obsesionado con ser mejor futbolista cada partido, como si el resultado fuera su marcapasos, ahora ya solo pendiente por fin del contrato con el Inter de Miami hasta 2028. La plena dedicación y su especial carácter no le dieron tiempo ni para estudiar, tampoco para aprender el inglés suficiente para viajar por el mundo, acostumbrado desde pequeño a disponer de un intérprete si hacía falta para hablar con la profesora de la escuela de Rosario. Incluso puede que no hubiera sido futbolista si su abuela Celia no le hubiese llevado de la mano al equipo del Grandoli. Introvertido en el aula y tímido en el barrio, siempre se expresó con la pelota, como si supiera desde pequeño que no necesitaba nada más para ser considerado posiblemente el mejor jugador de la historia, el número uno. Seguir leyendo

items.title: El estupor de los dos historiadores usados por el PP y Vox para proteger una cruz franquista: “¿Cómo voy a decir yo algo así?”
items.description: Habla César Rina , profesor titular de Historia Contemporánea en la UNED: “Cuando me avisaron, pensé que era broma. Pero, ¿cómo voy a decir yo algo así? ¡Si sostengo justo lo contrario!”. Toma la palabra Miguel Ángel del Arco Blanco , catedrático de Historia Contemporánea de la Universidad de Granada: “Han deformado mi trabajo”. Reputados investigadores sobre el franquismo, Rina y Del Arco, que esta semana ha sido galardonado con el Premio Nacional de Historia de España , tienen otras dos cosas en común. La primera, que son citados como fuentes de autoridad en la resolución de la Junta de Extremadura , gobernada por el PP y Vox, que inicia el proceso para declarar Bien de Interés Cultural (BIC) una afamada cruz franquista y evitar así su retirada. La segunda es el estupor y la indignación. Seguir leyendo Las alegaciones del Gobierno: “Fue construida expresamente para exaltar a los vencedores” El expediente para declarar BIC la Cruz de los Caídos de Cáceres se ha convertido en un objeto de controversia política y debate social en Extremadura. A las alegaciones de los historiadores César Rina y Miguel Ángel del Arco se han sumado las de asociaciones memorialistas como Armhex y Amececa, a favor de la retirada del monumento, y las de organizaciones católicas como Hazte Oír y Abogados Cristianos, partidarias de su mantenimiento. En total, la Junta ha recibido alrededor de un centenar de alegaciones, a las que debe dar respuesta antes de que concluya el expediente, que tiene una duración máxima de 16 meses, explica la Consejería de Cultura. Entre quienes han presentado objeciones está el Gobierno central, a través de la Secretaría de Estado de Memoria Democrática, que se opone a la protección de la Cruz de los Caídos con razones técnicas y también de fondo. El texto presentado por el Gobierno recuerda que la Junta, que hasta este agosto no había adoptado medidas para proteger el monumento, inició el expediente de declaración como BIC después de que el Ejecutivo lo incluyera en el Catálogo de Símbolos y Elementos Contrarios a la Memoria Democrática y ordenara su retirada, lo cual puede suponer “desviación de poder”, es decir, un uso de una potestad administrativa para fines distintos a los fijados por la ley. Las alegaciones gubernamentales aluden a la “ausencia de valores patrimoniales excepcionales” que justifiquen la protección, señalan que las modificaciones a la cruz en 1984 no desactivan su “función conmemorativa” y rechazan que pueda considerarse “un símbolo de reconciliación”. No es lo mismo —señala la Secretaría de Estado de Memoria Democrática— conservar, con ciertas modificaciones, un lugar que es testimonio de la represión, por ejemplo un antiguo campo de concentración, que preservar un monumento “construido expresamente para conmemorar y exaltar a los vencedores de la sublevación”. No es la primera vez que administraciones del PP remolonean a la hora de retirar ese tipo de símbolos. El pasado 30 de junio, el ministro de Política Territorial y Memoria Democrática, Ángel Víctor Torres, anunció la incorporación al catálogo de vestigios franquistas de dos monumentos y dos inscripciones que, de acuerdo a lo previsto en la Ley de Memoria Democrática, deberán ser retirados. Se trata del monumento a la Victoria de Santa Cruz de Tenerife, conocido coloquialmente como “monumento a Franco”; el de los rumanos caídos de Majadahonda (Madrid); y dos inscripciones de homenaje a José Antonio Primo de Rivera, fundador de Falange, en las catedrales de Almería y de Murcia. Para su retirada, el Gobierno central dio plazos de entre tres y seis meses a los gobiernos del PP y los obispados.

items.title: Los acampados de Sol se debaten entre resistir o levantar las tiendas para organizar la huelga general y buscan un “cierre memorable”
items.description: Hay una pregunta que se repite en la acampada de Sol: “¿Nos vamos o nos quedamos?”. El debate se extiende por las más de 1.500 tiendas como la rabia que encendió esta protesta la noche del 26 de septiembre tras la manifestación por el desahucio de Maricarmen Abascal . Casi un mes después, la incógnita sobre hasta cuándo resistir ha llegado esta semana a la primera página de La lona , el periódico de la ciudad montada en Sol. La respuesta no es sencilla. Tampoco unívoca. Algunos insisten en aguantar hasta la huelga general del 11 de noviembre . Otros quieren desacampar ya para organizar una segunda etapa de movilización en los barrios. Incluso hay quienes plantean una acampada indefinida hasta que se logren soluciones reales a la crisis de vivienda. La única certeza es que, antes de abandonar Sol, se debe publicar un manifiesto. Y los habitantes de esta ciudad laberíntica con 40 plazas ya han empezado a redactarlo. Seguir leyendo

items.title: El Atlético de Madrid hace una “revisión preventiva” sobre el profesor detenido por abusos sexuales que trabajó en su cantera
items.description: Antes de ser profesor de un colegio religioso de Madrid, Mario F., detenido el pasado día 13 por agredir sexualmente al menos a diez menores de entre 12 y 15 años , había trabajado como preparador de porteros en la cantera del Atlético de Madrid. Según detalló la policía en una nota de prensa, al maestro se le considera responsable de" tres delitos continuados de agresión sexual completa a menor de 16 años , otros tres delitos de agresión sexual a menores de 16 años —víctimas diferentes a las anteriores—, prostitución infantil, pornografía infantil y child grooming" . El child grooming (conocido en español como acoso sexual a menores o engaño pederasta) es una práctica en la que un adulto se pone en contacto con un niño, niña o adolescente con el fin de ganarse su confianza de forma progresiva para involucrarlo en una actividad de explotación o abuso sexual. El detenido tiene 38 años, mientras que las víctimas son todas menores de 16. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Francesc Augé recibirá la eutanasia el 27 de noviembre, tras más de dos años varado en los juzgados
items.description: Francesc Augé ya tiene fecha para recibir la eutanasia que tanto ansiaba y que ha visto paralizada en los tribunales durante más de dos años. Será el próximo 27 de noviembre, la fecha que ha escogido para ejercer su derecho a morir con dignidad, según ha explicado él mismo y ha confirmado este diario a través de su abogada. “Quería hacerlo el día de las elecciones [del 29-N], pero en domingo no puede ser… Es el día más cercano, porque ningún partido político ha mostrado respeto”, explica a este diario Augé, que en este tiempo de espera, un total de 856 días desde que le fue concedido el derecho por el órgano competente, se ha mostrado muy crítico con los poderes públicos al ver lastrada su voluntad en los tribunales . “No respetan mi derecho a morir”, lamentaba en una entrevista con este diario. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Amigas en la oficina, un salvavidas para no ahogarse en la rutina laboral contemporánea
items.description: En 1980, unas jóvenes Jane Fonda, Lily Tomlin y Dolly Parton interpretaban en Nine to Five (Coling Higgins) a tres empleadas de una empresa que soportan a diario las actitudes machistas de su déspota y autoritario jefe. Tras un accidente que casi le cuesta la vida a dicho supervisor, se alían para trazar un plan y salir airosas de esta situación que, de hecho, termina jugando a su favor: durante su ausencia, ponen en marcha una serie de propuestas progresistas que mejoran las condiciones de sus compañeras y, cuando su jefe se reincorpora, se entera de que dichas medidas obtienen el reconocimiento del propio CEO por sus buenos resultados, lo que le obliga a, por fin, respetarlas. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Poisoned bottle: How Kenyans are drinking themselves to an early grave
items.description: Kenyas illicit alcohol trade is fuelling deadly poisonings, with counterfeit spirits, tax evasion and weak enforcement putting lives at risk.

items.title: Paul Banks, de Interpol: “Dejar las drogas y el alcohol no fue tan difícil. Era el momento y estaba listo”
items.description: Sentado en la suite de un precioso hotel, con un iced latte en la mano, a Paul Banks (Essex, 48 años) se le aprecian pocas secuelas de aquella vida intoxicada que llevó y que casi lo manda al otro barrio. Al cantante de Interpol se le ve feliz en su madurez. Su banda, que brilló en el Nueva York de principios de los dosmiles al calor del revival post-punk , disfruta ahora de una segunda juventud, aupado por una generación que vuelve a venerar el arquetipo del indie atormentado a lo Ian Curtis, con quien siempre se comparó a Banks. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Ryan Reynolds, el actor que conquistó Hollywood en la cuarentena, cumple 50 años convertido en un magnate casi inmune a las críticas
items.description: Ryan Reynolds cumple 50 años este viernes 23 de octubre, pero a estas alturas es probable que esté saturado de celebraciones. El 30 de septiembre fue el cumpleaños de su hija Inez; el 4 de octubre, el de su hija Betty; y, el 12 de octubre, el de su amigo Hugh Jackman , que es casi como uno más de la familia —además del protagonismo en Deadpool y Lobezno , ambos comparten la propiedad de BONDS Flying Roos, un equipo australiano que compite en la liga internacional de vela—. “Me paso el día respirando helio, inflando globos, vaciándolos, volviendo a inflarlos”, confesaba el actor canadiense a la revista People a principios de septiembre, cuando bautizó esta época del año como el “callejón de los cumpleaños” del que no puede escapar. “No me gustan los cumpleaños. O sea, no me quejo por tener uno, pero tampoco soy de los que dicen: ‘Oye, organicemos una gran fiesta para mí’. Estoy bien, ya recibo suficiente atención”, confirmó sobre sus expectativas por alcanzar el medio siglo de vida. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Nuclear uncertainty
items.description: CONSIDERING the poor state of bilateral relations between Pakistan and India, there is always a possibility of miscalculating a situation, especially in the absence of regular contact. These concerns take on greater importance in the nuclear domain. In this regard, officials associated with Pakistan’s nuclear programme have rightly warned that India’s reported attempt to alter the strategic balance has heightened risks of escalation in South Asia. Speaking at a conference in Islamabad, retired Lt-Gen Khalid Kidwai, adviser to the National Command Authority, highlighted a report by the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, which said that India had deployed nuclear warheads on a submarine as part of “deterrence patrols”. He also cited New Delhi’s lack of advance notification for ballistic missile tests. The official observed that these developments cast doubt on India’s no-first-use policy, and were seen as an “irresponsible escalatory transition” towards nuclear asymmetry. Lack of coordination between nuclear states creates great unknowns, and such a situation is untenable in a neighbourhood as volatile as South Asia. It should be remembered that it was only last year that Pakistan and India confronted each other on the battlefield, illustrating how quickly matters can escalate. In such an atmosphere, India’s apparent attempts to alter the strategic balance are cause for serious concern. As Lt-Gen Kidwai pointed out, Pakistan may “review and reconsider” its deployment options, while reminding New Delhi of this country’s full spectrum deterrence policy. With matters frozen in the political and diplomatic spheres, it will take military-to-military engagement to prevent miscalculation in the strategic sphere. This can be carried out through the directors general military operations hotline, or via other appropriate channels. India’s political class — as well as military officials — has issued jingoistic statements targeting Pakistan. There is certainly no room for such bluster where the issue of nuclear weapons is concerned. To ward off any potential catastrophe, the situation must be handled in a rational manner and lines of communication need to be kept open to ensure conventional or nuclear signals are not misconstrued. India should halt its highly provocative nuclear-armed submarine patrols and engage with Pakistan to ensure there are no misunderstandings, particularly in the strategic sphere. Regular diplomatic engagement may seem distant at this juncture, but contact between the defence command structures should continue, while de-escalation mechanisms should also be maintained. Most of all, India should give up its rash attitude and approach the issue with maturity if it wants to reduce tensions and advance regional peace. Published in Dawn, October 23rd, 2026

items.title: CONSULTATIONS POLITIQUES BURKINA FASO – TÜRKIYE: Des concertations tous azimuts pour renforcer la coopération
items.description: En séjour à Ankara dans le cadre de la première session des consultations politiques entre le Burkina Faso et la République de Türkiye, la délégation burkinabè conduite par le Camarade Secrétaire général du Ministère des Affaires étrangères, l’Ambassadeur Hermann Yirigouin TOE a mené des concertations tous azimuts les 20 et 21 octobre 2026 avec de nombreuses personnalités au sein de diverses structures étatiques turques. C’est ainsi que la délégation s’est rendue tour à tour à la Fondation Maarif, à l’Agence de Coopération et de Coordination (TIKA), au Conseil de l’enseignement supérieur, au Ministère de la Santé, au Conseil des Relations Économiques Extérieures (DEIK), et au Ministère de l’Éducation nationale. À la Fondation MAARIF, l’Ambassadeur Hermann Yirigouin TOE et sa délégation ont eu des échanges avec Anet BEY, responsable Afrique de la Fondation MAARIF, assisté de collaborateurs. Il s’est réjoui de la signature d’une convention d’établissement et de gestion avec la fondation qui possède déjà des écoles à Ouagadougou et Bobo-Dioulasso et de l’octroi de bourses pour des élèves burkinabè. Elle a en outre sollicité l’appui de la fondation pour l’augmentation du nombre de ces bourses et l’appui en matière d’enseignement et de formation professionnelle et technique. MAARIF a marqué son accord pour l’ensemble de ces sollicitations. Les deux parties ont aussi examiné les possibilités de développement des activités de la fondation au Burkina Faso. À l’Agence de Coopération et de Coordination (TIKA) qui est l’agence turque de développement fondée en 1992, le Secrétaire général du Ministère des Affaires étrangères a été reçu par le Dr Yahya COSKUN, Vice-Président de l’institution. TIKA a de nombreuses réalisations au Burkina. Elle a entre autres accompagné le développement de la médecine d’urgence avec le SAMU. L’Agence s’est dite favorable à un réexamen dudit projet pour sa mise en œuvre. Pour l’année 2027, elle s’est engagée à apporter un appui au Burkina dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle et technique en cohérence avec l’objectif de développement endogène du pays. La délégation burkinabè a également émis le vœu qu’un Bureau TIKA puisse s’ouvrir à Ouagadougou. Au Conseil de l’enseignement supérieur, les discussions entre Burkinabè et Turcs ont essentiellement porté sur la question du renouvellement du protocole d’accord de 2024 qui fixe notamment les conditions de coopération en matière académique et universitaire et qui est arrivé à échéance. D’emblée le Burkina a exprimé sa volonté de préserver les acquis, de maintenir cette coopération et de la renforcer. Le Conseil turc de l’enseignement supérieur est également favorable à ce renouvellement et promet une augmentation du nombre de bourses pour les masters et doctorats au profit des étudiants burkinabè. La partie turque s’est dite ouverte à toute proposition d’amélioration de notre coopération dans le cadre du nouvel accord. D’ores et déjà une liste des besoins hiérarchisés du Burkina sera transmise à la Türkiye. Les chercheurs burkinabè pourront également accéder et postuler à la banque de projets des centres de recherche turcs. Au Ministère de la Santé, la délégation burkinabè a été reçue par le Vice-Ministre, Pr Nurullah OKUMUS. L’Ambassadeur Hermann Yirigouin TOE a salué le dynamisme de la coopération entre nos deux pays en matière de santé avec comme réalisation concrète la réussite de la première transplantation rénale au Burkina Faso. Le Vice-Ministre turc a exprimé la volonté de son pays de continuer à soutenir le Burkina Faso pour les transplantations d’organes. Ce soutien va se traduire par la formation des formateurs et leur mise à niveau en fonction de l’évolution des connaissances dans le domaine. Il s’est également dit favorable à la facilitation de conventions entre les hôpitaux publics turcs et le ministère burkinabè de la santé dans le cadre de l’approfondissement de la coopération sanitaire. Le Pr Nurullah OKUMUS a marqué un intérêt pour le projet de technopôle pharmaceutique de Kokologho qui pourrait offrir des possibilités d’investissement à des entreprises turques. Au Conseil des Relations Economiques Extérieures (DEIK) qui regroupe quatre mille (4 000) entreprises turques, les discussions ont débouché sur la proposition de tenue au Burkina d’un forum d’affaires et d’investissement entre le Burkina Faso et la Türkiye. Les exportations turques en direction du Burkina sont passées de 122,24 millions de dollars US en 2023 à 177,84 millions de dollars US en 2025. Cette croissance témoigne du dynamisme de nos relations commerciales et l’Ambassadeur TOE a salué le rôle important joué par DEIK dans le rapprochement des entreprises turques et burkinabè. Il a exhorté l’institution à une forte implication dans le règlement des litiges entre Turcs et Burkinabè pour éviter que les entreprises burkinabè ne soient toujours lésées. DEIK par la voie de Madame Vahit Oguz Cetin, une de ses dirigeantes pour l’Afrique de l’Ouest, a plaidé pour une facilitation des transactions bancaires et un accord sur la suppression de la double imposition. La partie burkinabè a expliqué que cette question de double imposition est prise en compte au niveau confédéral au sein de la Confédération des Etats du Sahel (AES). Elle a encouragé la co-entreprise et l’instauration de partenariats durables entre autres dans l’agroalimentaire, la chaîne du froid, le textile, l’énergie solaire, les mines, la formation technique, etc. pour booster le développement économique national. Au Ministère turc de l’Éducation nationale, les échanges ont principalement porté sur la problématique d’amélioration de la qualité de l’éducation voulue et recherchée par le Burkina pour soutenir son projet de transformation économique et sociale du pays dans le cadre de la Révolution progressiste populaire. Le département turc de l’éducation s’est dit prêt à examiner toutes les options en matière de formation des enseignants et des administrateurs du système éducatif, de partage d’expérience dans le cadre de la formation professionnelle et technique, de partage des programmes scolaires et des curricula de formation, d’implémentation de nouvelles filières. Il a aussi proposé des projets de jumelage entre les écoles turques et burkinabè pour un brassage des peuples, l’ambition étant de laisser aux générations futures un capital de relations fondées sur l’amitié et la coopération. Entre deux concertations, l’Ambassadeur Hermann Yirigouin TOE et sa délégation se sont rendus au Mausolée d’Atatürk du nom de Mustapha Kemal ATATÜRK, le fondateur de la République de Türkiye. Un retour aux sources de la Türkiye moderne, riche en enseignements sur la détermination d’un homme et le nationalisme d’un peuple qui a su assumer son destin et s’imposer dans le concert des nations. items.title: Los baños de bares y restaurantes: el gran marrón
items.description: Llego al restaurante, un bar de menú de currantes normal y corriente, a eso de las tres, con hambre . Me asignan una mesa, pero antes de sentarme a comer, necesito usar el baño. Lo encuentro al fondo del local. Tras una puerta, aparecen un lavamanos solitario y un pequeño pasillo con dos puertas más. Tras la primera puerta hay un bodegón de urinario masculino, retrete salpicado y charco en el suelo. En la segunda puerta hay un cartel pegado con celo con un mensaje a boli que reza “la puerta no cierra”. En efecto, la puerta no tiene ni pomo, y no cierra. Queda entreabierta. Es el baño adaptado para personas con movilidad reducida, y también el de mujeres, una habitación cuadrada de tres metros por tres. No tengo el brazo lo suficientemente largo (ni yo ni nadie, supongo) para resolver la situación como lo he hecho otras veces en circunstancias similares, pero más estrechas: manteniendo la puerta cerrada apoyándome en ella con una mano extendida mientras meo en cuclillas y de puntillas con el bolso colgando del cuello para que no toque el suelo, porque no hay ni gancho ni taburete a la vista donde dejarlo. Mientras sopeso la situación aparece otra mujer con intención de usar el baño. Tras un par de vistazos y de escuetas deliberaciones nos organizamos para aguantar la puerta, montar guardia la una para la otra y mear por turnos. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Burkina Faso: 2 800 milliards FCFA pour « l’Énergie pour Tous » dans 10 ans
items.description: Le Conseil des Ministres s'est réuni ce jeudi, sous la présidence du Camarade Capitaine Ibrahim TRAORÉ, Président du Faso, Chef de l'État, Président du Conseil des Ministres. Selon le Ministre des Serviteurs du Peuple, le Camarade Mathias TRAORÉ assurant l’Intérim du Ministre Porte-parole du Gouvernement, le Conseil a délibéré sur les dossiers inscrits à son ordre du jour et pris des décisions importantes pour la bonne marche de la Nation, conformément aux orientations de la Révolution Progressiste Populaire (RPP). Pour le compte de la Présidence du Faso, le Conseil a adopté un décret portant création de l'Initiative Présidentielle Énergie pour Tous « Faso Wa-Fulu », en langue nationale san. Portée par le Ministère en charge de l'Énergie, cette initiative d'envergure nationale vise à garantir un accès généralisé à l'électricité d'ici à 2030. D’un coût de plus de 2 800 milliards FCFA sur 10 ans, le programme s'articule autour de 4 composantes que sont les Brigades d'électrification, l’Inclusion communautaire, l’Accès énergétique et la Souveraineté énergétique. « Cette initiative vise à accélérer l’accès de l'énergie pour tous à l'horizon 2030. C'est une initiative qui va s'étaler sur une période de 10 ans, avec une première période d'accélération de la prise en charge des questions énergétiques et une seconde phase de 5 ans qui sera consacrée à la consolidation des acquis », a expliqué le Ministre de l'Énergie, des Mines et des Carrières, le Camarade Yacouba Zabré GOUBA. Naissance de la Société viticole du Burkina Faso (SOVIB) Au titre du Ministère de l'Industrie, du Commerce et de l'Artisanat, le Conseil a adopté un décret portant création d’une société d'économie mixte à participation publique majoritaire dénommée Société viticole du Burkina Faso (SOVIB). Pour le Ministre du Commerce, de l'Industrie et de l'Artisanat, le Camarade Serge Gnaniodem PODA, cette société d'économie mixte est dotée d'un capital initial d’un milliard FCFA avec une participation de 45 % pour l’État, 10 % pour BRAFASO et 45 % pour le secteur privé burkinabè. « La SOVIB permettra la création de centaines d’emplois et la transformation de vignes produites au Burkina Faso », a soutenu le Ministre PODA. Cette unité industrielle sera basée à Bobo-Dioulasso, et nécessitera un investissement d'environ 9,8 milliards FCFA. items.title: State contracts alone won’t build business giants – GIPA CEO
items.description: Ghanaian businesses must build lasting strength beyond government contracts to become business giants, the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Investment Promotion Authority (GIPA), Simon Madjie, said. Speaking on JoyNews’ PM Express Business Edition recently, he questioned whether dependence on state contracts offered a sustainable route to growth. “The understanding is that should the growth be organic when you become more stable, or should it just be one where the government gives them contracts, and then afterwards, what happens next?” He warned that such dependence could produce businesses driven by political opportunities rather than sound commercial principles. “So then they become like political entrepreneurs, and not necessarily business people who are following the principles that will allow their businesses to grow.” Madjie cited Kasapreko as an example of a Ghanaian business that had grown by understanding and developing its value chain. He argued that building strong domestic businesses had long informed state interventions. He pointed to local content regulations, Ghana Exim, and agencies that provide capital to Ghanaian enterprises. “It’s to build strong local businesses.” But he said the ambition now extended beyond helping businesses succeed within Ghana. According to him, the new GIPA law gives the authority the power to support Ghanaian businesses investing abroad. He explained that the objective was to help successful local companies enter other African markets and expand globally. Such businesses could expand overseas and bring profits back home. Madjie warned that Ghanaian companies needed to pursue opportunities beyond the domestic market as competition increased within the African Continental Free Trade Area. Locally, he said GIPA was mapping investment opportunities across districts and regions to help businesses identify prospects they might otherwise miss. The authority was also organising regional investment roadshows and encouraging Ghanaian businesses to explore opportunities outside their existing markets. “We are encouraging Ghanaian businesses to come along to the regions to see the opportunities that are in those regions, as well, so they can also take advantage of them.” For Madjie, supporting domestic investors remained essential to the government’s success. “No government will succeed by diminishing the influence of its local businesses or domestic investors. No government.”

items.title: Wa West records 92 percentage yellow fever vaccination
items.description: Yellow fever vaccination in Wa West District has hit 92%, with the Ghana Health Service Director-General Dr. Samuel Kaba Akoriyea, declaring that the vaccine is free, dry, very safe and internationally approved. So far, only one mild headache has been recorded as a side effect out of 225,446 people vaccinated. Speaking at Siriyiri in Wa West District as part of a region-wide campaign targeting persons aged 9 months to 60 years, Dr. Samuel Kaba said 79,238 males and 92,768 females have been vaccinated, expressing worry that men are not coming out. “Only one person had a little headache because of fear out of over 225,446. The yellow fever vaccine is free, dry, and very safe. No one should die because a vaccine is available,” he said. To achieve 100% yellow fever coverage, he announced house-to-house mop-up under Free Primary Health Care, collaboration with Veterinary Services to vaccinate nomadic Fulani herdsmen moving with cattle, and a call to report sick persons from neighbouring countries. To support the yellow fever mop-up, he has deployed 100 motorbikes to Upper West Region – 15 have arrived; the rest will arrive later and will be assembled in Wa by local mechanics with maintenance training – warning he will withdraw them if not maintained. Regional Director Dr. Josephat A. Nyuzaghl said the fleet will prioritise yellow fever-affected districts. Assembly Member for Siriyiri Electoral Area, Osman Adams, on behalf of the Chief of Siriyiri, said only 2 nurses serve 2,360 people across 5 communities. Moved by the situation, the health services Director General ordered the Upper West Regional Director of Health Services, Dr. Joshephat Nyuzagl to release 5 motorbikes for Siriyiri before he lands in Accra in the next few hours. Dr. Samuel Kaba called health workers the heroes behind 225,446 vaccinations and said the president’s incentive promise in Daffiama stands. “If we don’t cover 100% yellow fever vaccination, I cannot go to sleep,” he stressed.

items.title: Three terrorists killed as forces foil attack in Gwadar
items.description: GWADAR/QUETTA: Security forces killed three terrorists and foiled an attack on an unoccupied construction company camp in Gwadar, officials said on Thursday. Security sources said forces had surrounded several other suspected terrorists near a hotel, and an operation was underway to thwart another attempted attack. The construction camp that was targeted by terrorists affiliated with Fitna al-Hindustan was empty, and no casualties were reported, officials said. However, the attackers set fire to several trucks parked along a nearby road, they added. The state uses the term Fitna al-Hindustan for Balochistan-based terrorist groups, such as the BLA, to highlight Indian involvement in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan. Officials denied reports of attacks on security forces, intelligence agencies and their camps, describing information circulating on social media as baseless, and urged the public not to treat unverified reports and claims circulated by terrorist organisations as established facts. Security situation Meanwhile, in a joint statement, the Gwadar administration and police said reports circulating on social media about the security situation were inaccurate. The law and order situation in the BP-250 area and its surroundings was under control following timely action by security forces and relevant intelligence agencies, the statement said. The statement urged the public not to pay heed to unverified reports or spread rumours, advising people to rely on authentic information issued by the police and relevant government institutions. Gwadar police assured residents that necessary measures were being taken to maintain law and order. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, in a post on X, lauded security forces for thwarting the attack and praised their professionalism in eliminating terrorists. Published in Dawn, October 23rd, 2026

Les 20 et 21 octobre , ses équipes ont mené une opération dans plusieurs débits de boissons à Koupéla, dans la province du Kourittenga, avec un accent particulier sur le respect de la réglementation des prix. Cette opération a ciblé notamment des maquis, des caves et des dépôts de boissons. Elle vise à renforcer le contrôle des pratiques commerciales et à contribuer à la lutte contre les hausses irrégulières de prix. La DRICA-Nakambé invite les populations à signaler tout comportement contraire à la réglementation auprès de ses services, afin de contribuer à la protection des consommateurs et au respect des règles commerciales. items.title: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
items.description: Paris is extending a partial curfew that restricts movement in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon impose a total ban on protests this weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums in the French capital will also be closed on Saturday as more demonstrations are expected. France is still reeling from major disorder at the weekend, when large protests against the high cost of living and school conditions were overshadowed by riots and looting that saw business and historic buildings destroyed. In other parts of the country where protests have not been banned completely, President Emmanuel Macron said only authorised union demonstrations will be allowed on Saturday. Interior Minister Jean-Didier Berger said police deployments would be increased by 20% compared to last weekend, after the government was accused of being blindsided by the scale of the unrest. France’s justice minister said on Thursday that 217 people had been jailed over last weekend’s disorder after being convicted in fast-track trials, with that number expected to rise. Gérald Darmanin said authorities had arrested 2,700 people across France, and more than 1,000 had appeared in court. Half of those detained had no prior criminal record, he said, according to Le Figaro newspaper. Police in Paris said its curfew in Place de la République, where protesters gathered last weekend, and the Les Halles shopping area will be extended until Monday. Movement will be prohibited in both areas from 23:00 local time (21:00 GMT) until 06:00 the following morning, the capital’s prefecture said, adding that Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez and Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu had ordered it. Public transport in Marseille will be suspended on Saturday to try to prevent a repeat of the city’s riots. The city saw some of the worst violence last weekend and damage to more than 500 businesses. The prefecture for the Rhône region, which covers Marseille, said a curfew for minors would be extended to the entire population overnight on Saturday 24 October, from 23:00 to 05:00 (21:00 – 03:00 GMT). Similar announcements have been made in Nice in the south, Toulon on the south coast, the centre of Rouen in the north-west, and Grenoble in the east. Macron met with intelligence services and ministers on Thursday to prepare for Saturday’s next national day of protests. “The general recommendation is that there should be no demonstrations. Those who want to continue to demonstrate, when they are trade union organisations, will have alternative routes proposed by the prefects,” the French president announced. “When they’re not union organisations, wherever possible, they’ll be banned.” He attacked what he called “political and even seditious acts organised by far-left groups that aim to bring down the Republic”. Curfews were imposed in several cities after the weekend rioting, and Macron said the government wanted a return to calm. The gilets jaunes (yellow-vest) movement was behind many of last weekend’s protests, and Paris authorities have banned several of their proposed marches. Partial curfews variously restricting the movement of young people and gatherings have been in place this week in cities including Marseille, Bordeaux, Nice and Lyon in the south as well as Lille and other towns in the north. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu promised a “massive” deployment of police officers this week to handle any unrest this weekend, but some officers have told French media they are not trained to handle large crowds. Unrest spread across several French cities last weekend, including the capital Paris Around 550,000 people took part in demonstrations on 17 October to protest rising fuel prices and the cost of living, which have escalated after weeks of student protests . Marches were largely peaceful and took place in several major French cities, including Paris, and were backed by unions, gilets jaunes, and student groups. But they were marred by scenes of violence, looting and destruction. Lyon’s tourism office was set on fire by demonstrators during last weekend’s protests. In Limoges, the clock tower and parts of the ornate city hall roof were engulfed in flames before collapsing on Saturday. A second suspect aged 66 was arrested on Thursday, after a man in his 30s was detained on suspicion of the attempted murder of police officers who were in the city hall when the fire started. The iconic Place de la République was vandalised in the capital, Paris, when groups of rioters took over parts of the city, wreaking havoc. The unrest has come as Macron enters the final months of his presidency, with elections scheduled for 18 April and 1 May next year.

items.title: Nkoranza South MP commissions modern six-unit classroom block to end decades of Congestion
items.description: For years, the pupils of Asunkwaa M/A Primary School in the Nkoranza South Constituency of the Bono East Region studied under conditions that tested both their patience and their potential. With some classrooms bursting at the seams, accommodating as many as 90 pupils at a time, teachers struggled to cope, and learning suffered. But that narrative has now changed. A Community’s Long Wait Ends The school, which has long grappled with severe overcrowding due to rising enrollment, has finally received a brand-new six-unit classroom block funded by the Ghana Education Trust Fund (GETFund). The facility was officially commissioned in a brief but colorful ceremony attended by dignitaries, traditional leaders, and jubilant community members. Headmaster Atta Augustine described the years of struggle with candid honesty. “The situation was very challenging for us. Imagine having ninety pupils in one classroom. It was difficult for teachers to give individual attention to students. Marking exercises alone was a herculean task. We needed help, and we needed it urgently.” The new block, he noted, will not only ease congestion but also create a more conducive environment for teaching and learning—one where pupils can breathe, focus, and thrive. Government’s Commitment to Rural Education Speaking at the commissioning ceremony, the Member of Parliament for Nkoranza South and Minister for Labour, Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum, underscored the government’s dedication to bridging the educational gap between rural and urban communities. “This project is not just about bricks and mortar. It is about investing in our future. We want the children of Asunkwaa to have the same opportunities as those in the cities,” he said. The MP expressed optimism that the new facility would serve as a launchpad for future leaders, professionals, and change-makers. “My hope is that one day, from this very community, we will raise professors, lawyers, doctors, and many more professionals who will contribute to national development.” A Call for Maintenance The Bono East Regional Minister, Francis Owusu Antwi, who joined the MP and the Municipal Chief Executive for the ceremony, commended the government’s efforts while urging the community to take ownership of the facility. “This facility belongs to you. Take care of it. Let us work together to maintain it so that it can serve generations to come. The results we all desire will only come if we protect what has been given to us,” he advised. Traditional Authorities Express Gratitude For the chiefs and elders of Asunkwaa, the new classroom block is a dream fulfilled. The Dikro of Asunkwaa, Nana Osei Kofi, who spoke on behalf of the traditional council, expressed deep appreciation to the government and the MP. “We are grateful to the MP and the government for listening to our cry. Our children have suffered for too long. Today, we can smile. We say thank you from the bottom of our hearts.” A Brighter Future Ahead As the sun sets over Asunkwaa, the new classroom block stands as more than just a building—it is a symbol of hope, progress, and the power of collective effort. For the pupils of Asunkwaa M/A Primary School, the future looks brighter than ever before. The days of overcrowded classrooms and unbearable heat are gradually becoming a thing of the past, replaced by an environment where learning can truly flourish. The commissioning of this facility is a reminder that when government and community work hand in hand, meaningful change is not only possible—it is inevitable.

items.title: Entreprises publiques : 22,6 Mds DH de bénéfice net en 2024
items.description: Le Rapport sur l’État actionnaire 2024-2025 de l’ANGSPE établit à 22,6 milliards de dirhams le résultat net des entreprises et établissements publics de son périmètre en 2024, contre 6,8 milliards un an plus tôt. Un rebond porté par l’OCP et le redressement de l’ONEE, alors que les estimations du document pour 2025 tablent sur 13,5 milliards. Après un exercice 2023 beaucoup plus terne, les établissements et entreprises publics suivis par l’ANGSPE ont changé de dimension en 2024. La deuxième édition du Rapport sur l’État actionnaire met en évidence une hausse de 230% du résultat net consolidé, qui passe de 6,8 à 22,6 milliards de dirhams. En 2022, le même agrégat affichait encore une perte de 1,8 milliard. Le périmètre concerné compte 57 entités : 35 entreprises publiques, 15 établissements publics et 7 participations. Elles emploient 86 785 collaborateurs et pèsent, selon le rapport, 67% du chiffre d’affaires du secteur public, 95% de sa valeur ajoutée et 79% de son volume d’investissement. Leur chiffre d’affaires cumulé s’établit à 242,9 milliards de dirhams en 2024, en progression de 8%, tandis que la valeur ajoutée grimpe de 38%, à 118,4 milliards. Le résultat d’exploitation, lui, plus que double, de 18,3 à 41,8 milliards. Cette embellie a un premier moteur : le groupe OCP. Son résultat net gagne 6,2 milliards de dirhams, grâce à des cours mondiaux de la roche et des engrais plus favorables et à une meilleure maîtrise des coûts de production. Le chiffre d’affaires du groupe progresse de 5,7 milliards, avec des ventes d’engrais en hausse de 11% et d’acide phosphorique de 28%, quand celles de phosphates bruts reculent de 35%. L’OCP et l’ONEE concentrent à eux seuls 58% du chiffre d’affaires global. Le second moteur est le redressement de l’Office national de l’électricité et de l’eau potable. Son déficit opérationnel est ramené à 4,2 milliards de dirhams, contre 11,5 milliards en 2023, ce qui se traduit par un gain de 4,1 milliards sur son résultat net. D’autres entités contribuent à la dynamique : le Fonds Hassan II pour le développement économique et social (+2,9 milliards), la CDG (+2,2 milliards, avec un produit net bancaire en hausse de 34% pour des charges générales d’exploitation qui n’augmentent que de 7%) et Holding Al Omrane, repassé en territoire positif avec 257 millions de dirhams, après une perte de 1,17 milliard. Tout le portefeuille n’a pas suivi. Le résultat net de l’ANCFCC recule de 1,24 milliard, conséquence d’une contribution au Budget général de l’État passée de 4 à 6 milliards, que le rapport présente comme le signe d’une capacité de contribution accrue. Itissalat Al-Maghrib perd 0,77 milliard, après avoir comptabilisé 4,1 milliards au titre du litige avec Wana Corporate, tranché en appel en juillet 2024. MASEN cède 0,47 milliard et ADM 0,39 milliard, ce dernier pâtissant du recul de son résultat d’exploitation et de l’alourdissement des charges d’intérêt. Par pôle, les Mines, l’Eau, l’Énergie et l’Industrie dégagent 12,3 milliards, la Finance, l’Investissement et les Banques 8,6 milliards et les Infrastructures, Transports et Logistique 2,1 milliards, tandis que le pôle du développement territorial et celui du numérique et des médias affichent chacun un déficit limité à 0,2 milliard. Pour 2025, le rapport ne livre pas un bilan mais des estimations, établies avant la clôture de l’exercice. Selon elles, le résultat net se replierait d’environ 40%, à 13,5 milliards de dirhams, sous l’effet des performances attendues de l’ONEE et de l’OCP. Le chiffre d’affaires gagnerait 3%, à 250,3 milliards, et le résultat d’exploitation 2%, à 42,5 milliards. La valeur ajoutée fléchirait de 6%, à 112,8 milliards, en raison du transfert de la distribution d’électricité aux sociétés régionales multiservices. L’Agence souligne que ces niveaux resteraient nettement supérieurs à ceux de 2022 et de 2023. La structure financière confirme l’empreinte de quelques grands acteurs. Les capitaux propres atteignent 355,4 milliards de dirhams, en hausse de 7,2%, dont près de trois quarts reviennent à quatre entités : l’OCP (122,7 milliards), le Fonds Hassan II (88,7 milliards), la CDG (24,6 milliards) et l’ONCF (22,1 milliards). Les dettes de financement s’élèvent à 357,5 milliards, soit 5,1% de plus qu’en 2023, avec un groupe OCP qui en détient 32% après avoir mobilisé 33,6 milliards supplémentaires par émissions obligataires et tirages auprès d’institutions financières internationales. L’ONEE, l’ONCF, ADM et la CDG complètent le peloton de tête, de sorte que cinq entités concentrent 75% de l’endettement. Le total du bilan atteint 1 662,6 milliards. Cet appétit de financement accompagne un effort d’investissement en forte accélération : 80 milliards de dirhams en 2024, contre 62,8 milliards en 2023, dont 55% pour le seul groupe OCP, qui y consacre 43,6 milliards. L’ONEE et Holding Al Omrane en représentent respectivement 9% et 7%. Pour 2025, le rapport estime ces dépenses à 132,5 milliards, soit 66% de plus, avec 15 milliards supplémentaires pour l’ONCF, mobilisés par la ligne à grande vitesse, et 9,4 milliards de plus pour l’OCP, auxquels s’ajoutent TMSA (+4,5 milliards), l’ONEE (+4 milliards), l’ANCFCC et l’ONDA (+2,6 milliards chacun). Reste la question des flux entre le portefeuille et le Trésor. En 2024, les entités du périmètre ont versé 13,4 milliards de dirhams au Budget général de l’État, soit 6% de plus qu’en 2023. Les dividendes en représentent 52% et les produits de monopoles, parts de bénéfices et contributions d’établissements publics 46%. L’ANCFCC (6 milliards), l’OCP (5,8 milliards) et Maroc Telecom (0,7 milliard) fournissent l’essentiel. Dans l’autre sens, les transferts budgétaires de l’État vers ces mêmes entités totalisent 16,96 milliards, en repli de 12% sur 2023, ce qui place les sommes reçues environ 3,6 milliards au-dessus de celles versées. L’ONEE (4,9 milliards), l’ONCF (3,4 milliards), la SNRT (2,2 milliards), Casablanca Iskane et Équipement (1,6 milliard) et la RAM (1,5 milliard) absorbent 80% de l’enveloppe. L’appui à l’ONEE, reconduit à hauteur de 4 milliards, fait suite à une dotation exceptionnelle de 5 milliards en 2022 puis à 4 milliards en 2023. Pour 2025, les versements au Budget général sont estimés à 13,9 milliards, dont 11,9 milliards réalisés à fin septembre, tandis que les transferts de l’État monteraient à 19,8 milliards, en hausse de 17%. Environ 57% de cette somme, soit 11,3 milliards, financeraient l’investissement et 35%, soit 6,9 milliards, des dotations en capital. Les recettes attendues pour l’année budgétaire 2026 s’établissent à 15,5 milliards de dirhams. La carte de l’investissement 2024, enfin, reste très concentrée. Casablanca-Settat (30,98%), Marrakech-Safi (24,04%) et Rabat-Salé-Kénitra (14,05%) captent plus de 69% du total, soit environ 55 milliards de dirhams. Béni Mellal-Khénifra (8,49%) suit, devant Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma (6,02%), l’Oriental (4,31%), Laâyoune-Sakia El Hamra (4%), Souss-Massa (3,2%), Fès-Meknès (2,28%), Drâa-Tafilalet (1,3%), Guelmim-Oued Noun (0,76%) et Dakhla-Oued Ed-Dahab (0,58%). items.title: Microsoft develops AI tool that can diagnose ‘sequentially’ like a doctor
items.description: Microsoft researchers say an AI tool that diagnoses patients step by step, as doctors do, was more than twice as accurate as general physicians at solving complex medical cases, according to a study published Thursday in Science . The model identifies and coordinates the questions to ask a patient, as well as the exams and tests to order, using an “orchestrator” that organises how AI tackles a problem by employing a simulated panel of clinical experts collaborating to solve diagnostic cases, according to the report. Existing medical AI models typically take an all-at-once approach, examining a patient’s symptoms, lab results, and imaging studies to generate a diagnosis. With the orchestrator coordinating the steps to reach a diagnosis, the AI model first decides what to ask about the patient’s history and what ​in the physical exam is significant. Based on what it learns, it decides which tests to order, considers the results, and orders further testing as appropriate. All the while, it updates its working hypotheses and plans, the research leaders said in an interview. Tasked with diagnosing more than 300 highly unusual and confusing medical dilemmas, the ​model employing the diagnostic orchestrator was more than twice as accurate at “working up” the patient and determining the diagnosis ‌as ⁠general physicians using textbooks and the internet. The tool also outperformed human physicians on scenarios drawn from a major database of emergency room admissions. Assessments comparing these types of older systems to human doctors usually use multiple-choice questions, the researchers said. “AI has become very good at getting a 100% ​pass rate on those,” ​said Dr. Dominic King, ⁠the corporate vice president of the health unit at Microsoft AI, whose team is developing the new technology. “But of course, that’s not real-world. No ​patient ever came to see me with a nice summary.” The researchers also ​found that ⁠diagnostic processes cost less when the orchestrator designs the work-ups than when human doctors do. “We’re not just measuring the accuracy of the systems. We’re also measuring how judiciously and carefully it goes through a ⁠diagnostic ​work-up,” said Harsha Nori, head of AI at Microsoft AI ​Health. In a collaboration with Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston, the researchers will next test the tool’s ability to ​triage patients in emergency department waiting rooms.

items.title: Fissures take a toll on PTI internal discipline
items.description: • Gohar rejects resignation after Firdous Naqvi steps down from additional secretary general post • Mashal Yousafzai quits party WhatsApp groups over disagreements with top leadership ISLAMABAD: PTI’s Additional Secretary General Firdous Shamim Naqvi resigned from his position, while its outspoken senator Mashal Yousafzai quit the party’s WhatsApp groups over disagreements with the top leadership. The PTI, however, did not accept the resignation of Mr Naqvi and reportedly managed to convince the veteran member to withdraw his resignation. Ms Yousafzai, however, had a heated exchange with PTI interim chief Barrister Gohar Ali Khan and Secretary General Salman Akram Raja, which led to her quitting the WhatsApp groups. A source told Dawn that Senator Yousafzai was among the party leaders who expressed a lack of trust in the PTI leadership over its failure to secure the release of Imran Khan. She did so at a recent meeting of the core committee that spanned two days. On Thursday, she raised this issue once again. “Barrister Gohar threatened her that she may be expelled from the group. Over this Mashal Yousaf­zai said that she will quit the party groups and subsequently left WhatsApp groups of the parliamentary party and the core committee,” the source said. On the other hand, Barrister Gohar rejected Mr Naqvi’s resignation. Firdous Shamim Naqvi is an elected representative of the PTI with the authority to issue official notifications. “It was nothing but a disaster for the party…. Although Secretary General Salman Akram Raja has issued some of the notifications, those notifications cannot be accepted by the Election Commission of Pakistan, as the election watchdog had rejected the [intra-party] elections of the PTI and a case is going on in the Lahore High Court,” he explained. PTI leader Sheikh Waqas Akram said Mr Naqvi had resigned, but Barrister Gohar rejected his resignation. “I hope that situation will be controlled as he [Firdous Shamim Naqvi] has not left any Whatsapp group of the party,” he added. About Senator Yousafzai, he said the PTI senator left the groups “in the heat of the moment”, and hopefully the situation would be resolved soon. PTI workers arrested Police arrested three PTI supporters outside the Adiala jail after they arrived with their leaders to meet Imran Khan. Advocate Awais Younas Chaudhry told Dawn that Sardar Sadaqat Hayat, Muhammad Bilal Khan, Malik Asif Mehmood Kashif, Jaleel Shah, Malik Haris Awan and Nadia Khattak were included in the list for meeting with Mr Khan on Thursday. “Eleven of them, along with some workers, reached the Adiala jail, but the administration did not let them meet Imran Khan,” he said, adding that Malik Haris Awan and two workers Ali Raza and Umer Baig were later detained by the police. “I have informed the police that there was no case against Haris Awan and he had come to Adiala as per the directions of the Islamabad High Court, but the police are not willing to release them,” Advocate Chaudhry claimed. Published in Dawn, October 23rd, 2026

items.title: Gov’t targets textiles, agribusiness and auto components in investment push
items.description: Ghana is targeting textiles, agribusiness and component manufacturing as it seeks to attract investors with reforms that go beyond its reputation for political stability. The Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Investment Promotion Authority (GIPA), Simon Madjie, says the country’s investment pitch now centres on policy changes, credible leadership and an environment where businesses can grow. Speaking recently on JoyNews’ PM Express Business Edition , he pointed to sector policies at the Ministry of Trade as evidence of that approach. “There’s a new textiles policy, there is an agribusiness policy, you have one on component manufacturing.” Madjie said these initiatives formed part of efforts to position Ghana as a destination where investors could build and sustain profitable businesses. “All of these are geared towards making us that place where, when people think about Ghana, they think about a place to thrive, a place to do business, and a place to prosper.” His comments followed a question from host George Wiafe about growing competition for investment in West Africa. Wiafe asked whether Ghana’s traditional emphasis on peace and market size remained sufficient as neighbouring countries strengthened their appeal. Madjie acknowledged the competition but argued that Ghana’s proposition had evolved. “Ghana is not just selling political stability. Ghana is selling reforms.” He said changes to tax and customs laws were part of a broader effort to create prosperity for both investors and Ghanaians. For Madjie, attracting investment requires more than natural advantages. It also demands policies that help businesses expand over time. “Because you need reforms to keep growing your investment here.” He also placed credibility at the centre of Ghana’s appeal. He said investors needed confidence in leadership across government, from the presidency and ministries to agencies and local authorities. Madjie presented this as a long-term proposition, with sector policies and institutional leadership working together to support business growth. “So we know we have natural advantages, but we’ve moved beyond that to creating an environment where businesses can actually thrive and prosper.”

items.title: National Assembly proceedings succumb to lack of quorum, again
items.description: • CDA only demolishing illegal structures in Islamabad, assembly told • MNA raises concern over non-rehabilitation of Malir families displaced by ML-1 project • Lower house amends law to make State Life Insurance Company a statutory body ISLAMABAD: Proceedings in the National Assembly remained sluggish on Thursday, with only one bill passed before a lack of quorum forced the presiding officer to adjourn the sitting until Friday morning. The NA’s agenda for Thursday comprised 16 items, but the sitting was adjourned midway after a PTI MNA pointed out the lack of quorum. A headcount confirmed that the required number of members was not present. Abdul Qadir Patel, who was presiding over the sitting, allowed some additional time for the quorum to be completed, but the number of MNAs present remained below the required 88. The House was subsequently adjourned until Friday morning. During the question hour, the demolition of houses and other struc­tures in Islamabad, particularly in Sector E-12, came under discussion. Minister of State for Interior Tallal Chaudhry said the Capital Development Authority (CDA) had demolished only illegally constructed structures and houses. He said the shortage of graveyards was one of the major problems facing the city’s administration and residents. Most private housing schemes and societies, he added, had converted plots reserved for graveyards, schools, parks and mosques into commercial properties. Responding to a question, Railways Minister Hanif Abbasi informed the House that Pakistan Railways had recovered more than 200,000 kanals of land previously occupied through encroachments. Regarding the Main Line-1 (ML-1) railway project, he said Prime Min­ister Shehbaz Sharif would inau­gurate its first phase, involving the laying of 480 kilometres of railway track between Rohri and Karachi, at an estimated cost of $2.5 billion. MNA Syed Rafiullah said several families in Karachi’s Malir area had been rendered homeless by the ML-1 project, but had yet to be rehabilitated. During a question concerning facilities for Haj pilgrims, PTI MNA Shehryar Afridi expre­ssed displeasure when Parliamentary Secre­tary Kesoo Mal Kheal Das responded to the query. “It would have been better if a responsible member of the treasury benches or the minister for parliamentary affairs had answered the question,” Mr Afridi said. Mr Das responded by pointing out that a Hindu minister in India also handled Haj affairs, questioning Mr Afridi’s suggestion that the matter required a more responsible person to address it. Mr Afridi also said some private Haj organisers had made the religious obligation prohibitively exp­en­sive, with packages costing bet­ween Rs4 million and Rs5m. State Life Insurance Company After Question Hour, the National Assembly passed the Life Insurance (Nation­alisation) (Amend­ment) Bill, 2026. The bill provides for the federal government to establish a company, to be known as State Life Insurance Company Limited, under the Companies Act, 2017 (XIX of 2017). It states that the appointment of the company’s chief executive officer and board of directors will be made in accordance with the State-Owned Enterprises (SOE) Act and the Companies Act, 2017. Following the company’s incorporation under the Companies Act, 2017, the federal government will issue a vesting order, to be published in the official gazette, transferring all assets, liabilities, contracts, policies, proceedings and undertakings of the existing corporation to the company on a specified date and under terms and conditions determined by the government. The corporation will stand dissolved on the effective date, according to the bill. The legislation further provides that all employees and officers who have served the corporation continuously for at least one year immediately before the effective date, excluding those employed under project contracts, will be transferred to the new company on the same terms and conditions of service. Their existing rights and privileges, including pension entitleme­nts, post-retirement medical benefits, provident fund and gratuity, will also be protected, the bill states. Published in Dawn, October 23rd, 2026

items.title: At 67, new lawyer vows to defend the disadvantaged
items.description: Samuel Victor Addo, who was called to the Ghana Bar at 67 this year after retiring from a successful career in corporate America, says he intends to practise law actively, with a particular focus on helping disadvantaged and underserved people access legal assistance. Mr Addo said his decision to pursue law later in life was not simply about earning a professional qualification but also about putting his knowledge to use in supporting people who might otherwise struggle to obtain legal advice. Speaking on Joy FM’s Personality Profile with Lexis Bill on Thursday, October 22, he said he intended to begin with general legal practice while assessing the areas in which he could make the greatest contribution. “I plan to actively practise law, and I think it will be general practice because specialisation may take a while for you to figure out how to specialise and what if the area of your interest and specialisation is not really fulfilling or lucrative,” he said. Mr Addo explained that, for as long as his health and energy permitted, he wanted to remain active in the profession and use his skills to help people in need. “So, I think my plan is that, so far as I have the strength and the energy, I would continue to practise law with the aim of helping the disadvantaged, the indigent, and the underserved,” he said. Legal help beyond the courtroom Mr Addo said he also hoped to assist people within his family, social circles and personal networks who needed legal guidance. He noted that having a lawyer within a family could be valuable when important decisions had legal implications, helping relatives understand their options before committing themselves to a course of action. “And people in my social and personal orbit who need legal help or even advice. A lawyer in a family can also be very pivotal because there are decisions that will be made that need legal advice and legal input,” he said. His comments reflect his intention to make legal support accessible not only through formal representation but also through advice that could help people make informed decisions. Mr Addo said he expected to remain active in legal practice for as long as he was physically able. “So in that respect, I think I’ll be very active as far as practice of law is concerned,” he said. His decision to enter the legal profession at 67 follows his return to Ghana after a career in the United States, including work with Delta Air Lines. He has described his legal studies as demanding but rewarding and said his determination helped him complete the programme alongside much younger students. His next challenge will be to translate that qualification into practical service, particularly for people who need legal assistance but have limited means to obtain it.

items.title: Pakistan, EU flag security risks tied to Afghanistan
items.description: • At annual counterterrorism dialogue, bloc slams recent attacks in Pakistan • Talks cover online extremism, terror financing • Both sides agree to boost cooperation at multilateral forums • FO cites exploitation of water resources by states, terrorists ISLAMABAD: Pakistan and the European Union on Thursday expressed shared concern over the security threat emanating from Afghanistan at their annual counterterrorism dialogue. “Pakistan and the EU expressed concern at the security implications of the situation in Afghanistan”, both Pakistan and EU said in their statements on the 10th round of the Pakistan-EU bilateral counterterrorism dialogue in Islamabad, where the two sides reviewed the evolving terrorism threat landscape and reaffirmed their commitment to combating terrorism in all its forms. The Afghanistan reference in the statement followed more explicit language in the joint communiqué issued after the eighth Pakistan-EU Stra­tegic Dialogue in Islamabad on June 1. In that statement, the two sides had expressed “serious concern over the presence of terrorist entities in Afghanistan”, and said that Afghan territory must not be used to threaten or attack other countries, besides calling on the Afghan de facto authorities to take “effective and verifiable action” against all terrorist groups operating in or from Afghanistan. Although the statements after the counterterrorism dialogue did not repeat those specific demands, its significance lies in the fact that Afghanistan-related security concerns were again acknowledged and this time in the dedicated counterterrorism dialogue, rather than as part of a wider discussion of political and regional affairs. The reference is, moreover, significant because Pakistan has repeatedly urged international partners to press Afgha­nistan’s Taliban authorities to prevent terrorist groups from using Afghan territory to launch attacks across the border. The renewed emphasis on Afgha­nistan also follows recent EU engagement with the Taliban authorities. During a visit to Kabul from Oct 12 to 14, EU Special Envoy for Afghanistan Thomas Frellesen expressed concern over the continued presence and cross-border activities of terrorist groups with regional and global reach and urged the Taliban authorities to prevent Afg­han territory from being used by terrorist groups to threaten other countries. Even though the statements after counterterrorism dialogue and the strategic dialogue did not name any specific terrorist group of concern, Pakistan has consistently identified the Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan and affiliated groups and Baloch separatist outfits based in Afghanistan as the main threat. Islamabad has repeatedly deman­ded verifiable action by the Taliban authorities to neutralise these groups and prevent such attacks. The language used in EU statements, while expressing concern on the terrorism threat from Afghanistan, indicates continuity with the latest dialogue reaffirming common ground between the two sides on the security risks associated with Afghanistan. The discussions also covered evolving terrorist threats, including the exploitation of cyberspace, information and energy resources. Pakistan and the EU, the statements noted, exchanged best practices on preventing and countering violent extremism, terrorist financing and radicalisation, with particular attention to the use of cyberspace by terrorists. In a post on X, the Foreign Office said the dialogue also explored cooperation to counter the exploitation of water resources, besides other reso­urces, by terrorists as well as by states. The references to water resources and state actors did not appear in the separate official statements issued by Pakistan and the EU. Published in Dawn, October 23rd, 2026
